name: orbit-wine
description: CrossOver-class Wine for Orbit containers. Sources are not vendored in this repository.

release.notes: The Orbit Wine version: the CrossOver version, then Orbit's rebuild number. Bump the rebuild number whenever a patch or bundled library changes, so installed Orbits update (runtimes/orbit_wine.rs compares the numbers). 26.3.0-2: mmdevapi audio buffer (0003) and the SDL2 pad bridge.

crossover.notes: CrossOver 26.3.0 (Wine 11.0) already carries MSync (server/msync.c) and the winemac.drv D3DMetal hooks. Do not commit Apple GPTK or steamclient64 binaries.

mono.notes: The version CrossOver 26.3.0's mscoree requires. Without it wineboot waits on the Mono install prompt.

gecko.notes: Copied from the Gcenx bundle, which ships the version CrossOver 26.3.0 requires.

sdl2.notes: winebus' SDL backend maps Bluetooth and USB controllers to XInput. scripts/wine/build-sdl2.sh builds this version for x86_64 with Orbit's pad bridge (scripts/wine/patches/sdl2, no libusb), and build.sh bundles it instead of the Gcenx copy.
